summary: Frontend-only mobile-web validation completed for notifications diagnostics self-test additions. Both new buttons render, are tappable, and update their respective result rows without layout breakage.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking local self-test shows runtime unsupported message because Notifications.scheduleNotificationAsync is not available on web.
Remote self-test remains unavailable in web preview due missing native Expo push token.

action_items: On native device builds, verify local test triggers an actual notification banner/background alert.
On native device builds, verify remote self-push obtains Expo token and reaches Expo receipt status=ok.
Optional UX hardening: show explicit 'Not supported on web preview' message before invoking local test API.
critical_code_review_comments: Requested controls and result rows are implemented with stable testIDs and proper state wiring.
No regression seen in diagnostics card structure after adding self-test controls.
Current web behavior relies on thrown native API error text for local test failure; a platform guard would make diagnostics clearer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run validated only web-preview-safe UI/runtime behavior for diagnostics additions. Native push rendering and Expo delivery still require authenticated physical-device retest.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open /notifications, tap local test then remote self-test. Local path throws web unsupported API message from expo-notifications; remote path exits early when expoPushToken is absent on web. This is environment/platform limitation, not selector or layout regression. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
